title: BIR Form No. 2200-S — Excise Tax Return for Sweetened Beverages

choice_rows.label: Item 14 — Tax relief under a Special Law or Treaty?

validation.how: Field label turns red; messages list in a 'Needs review' section after Part III (first 20 only), and Queue for submission is disabled while any error exists.

lists.label: Schedule 1 — Computation of Excise Tax (beverage rows)

findings.now: Schedule 1 has one Others row behind an Include toggle, and the page has no Add or Delete for a second Others row.
findings.why: The official HTA adds and deletes Others rows with Add and Delete buttons (BIR-Form2200S.hta:1653 calling addFieldsForSched1 at line 7268), so a filer with more than one other beverage cannot enter the full Schedule 1.

options.name: Repeating Others cards
options.detail: Each Others row is a card with ATC, description, bracket, rate, sales and volume, plus Add and Remove buttons, as in the HTA.

options.name: Others table with Add row
options.detail: One table for all Others rows with an Add row button, a per-row Remove, and a total that feeds Item 18.

findings.now: Region, Province and City are each picked from a wrap of outline buttons, one button per place, opened by pressing the level button.
findings.why: The place data holds 17 regions, 86 provinces and 1,617 cities, and the 2200T page already uses searchable dropdowns for the same geography.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A searchable combobox per level (Region, then Province, then City), as on the 2200T page.

options.name: Select dropdown
options.detail: A plain dropdown per level, which keeps long lists out of the page flow.

findings.now: Item 1 month is a row of 12 outline buttons (Jan to Dec) that wraps across the Return period card.
findings.why: The official form uses a month select (frm2200S:txtMonth1, BIR-Form2200S.hta:442), and 12 options are far past the 4-option limit for buttons.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A 12-month combobox that accepts typing, so 'mar' selects March.

options.name: Select dropdown
options.detail: A plain Jan to Dec select, the same control the official form uses.

findings.now: A field with an error only turns its label red, the message appears in a Needs review section after Part III, and Queue for submission is disabled with no message beside it.
findings.why: The filer must scroll past Part III to learn which item blocks queueing, and the list stops after 20 messages.

options.name: Inline message
options.detail: Show the official alert text under the field it concerns, for example 'Please enter a valid Email Address on Item 11.'

options.name: Summary above the body
options.detail: Show the Needs review list above Part I with a link that scrolls to each item.

findings.now: Typing a sales value or volume of one trillion or more shows 'Enter non-negative amounts in pesos and centavos below one trillion.', and a Basic excise tax due that overflows shows no alert at all.
findings.why: The official computeBasicTaxDue alert 'Exceeded maximum amount of 999,999,999,999.99 on Basic Excise Tax Due.' (BIR-Form2200S.hta:7394 and 7419) also clears that row's sales and volume, which the page never does.

options.name: Official alert verbatim
options.detail: When a computed basic tax due exceeds 999,999,999,999.99, show the HTA sentence and reset that row's sales and volume to 0.00 as the HTA does.

options.name: Reject at entry
options.detail: Refuse the typed value at its field and show the official sentence there.

findings.now: Save draft writes the draft even when required items such as Item 6 or Item 7 are blank, and no official Save alert is ever shown.
findings.why: The official Save runs its own checks and returns after the first alert (validations.json save-phase rules 037 to 048, for example 'Please indicate a valid Day.' at BIR-Form2200S.hta:7709), while save_draft only stops on unparseable numbers.

options.name: Official Save checks
options.detail: Run the Save-phase checks before a non-draft save and show the first verbatim alert in Needs review.

options.name: Non-blocking notice
options.detail: Keep saving the draft, but show the first official Save alert as a notice.

findings.now: A one-digit day such as 5 is accepted and shown as 05, with no alert.
findings.why: The official HTA rejects a one-character day with 'Please enter a valid day on item 1. Format should be MM/DD/YYYY.' (BIR-Form2200S.hta:7714, validations.json 2200s-validate-006), and the page parses the day as a plain number.

options.name: Two-digit entry
options.detail: Require two digits and show the official alert when one digit is typed.

options.name: Pad with notice
options.detail: Keep the 05 display but raise the official alert once so the format is taught.

findings.field: Item 21 — Payment on returns previously filed (amended only)
findings.now: App-only messages such as 'Item 21 applies only to an amended return.' and 'Totals are out of date. Recompute the return.' appear in Needs review.
findings.why: Neither text appears in BIR-Form2200S.hta or validations.json, so the filer sees wording the official form never shows.

options.name: Keep as app note
options.detail: Keep the check but show it as a note outside the official alert list.

options.name: Remove
options.detail: Drop the message and rely on the official alerts.

findings.now: The 2200S commit adds a 130-line shared module (excise_places.rs) and 20 lines to the shared tools/official-xml/official.js, beyond the form's own files and one-line registrations.
findings.why: The module is now also imported by the 2200C and 2200AN forms, so a shared surface changed inside a form-only commit.

options.name: Separate commit
options.detail: Land the shared place data and the tool change as a separate reviewed commit.

options.name: Keep form-local
options.detail: Move the place lookups into the 2200S module and leave shared files alone.
